sections.title: Look Back (Review)
paragraphs: The first man was named Adam and his wife was named Eve. God placed Adam and Eve in a special garden. God had them oversee everything that happened in it. He gave Adam and Eve freedom in the garden. God often came there to spend time with them. This is what the Bible teaches.

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: The Bible tells us that one of God’s angels in heaven became prideful and rebelled against God. This rebellious angel tempted Adam and Eve to disobey God’s commands. Adam and Eve disobeyed God’s command and sinned for first time and they were punished. God had to send them away from His presence. He cast them out of the garden. Adam and Eve had children, and their children had children, and their children had children, until the whole world was filled with people.
Let’s read some verses from the Holy Scriptures, the Bible, that relate to this story.

These verses teach us that even when we sin, God does not turn away from us — He comes to us. When Adam and Eve sinned, God did not leave them to face the consequences alone; He sought them out and covered their shame. This is God's grace — God doesn’t wait for us to right ourselves; He makes us right, and He has done this through Jesus Christ. Jesus is the offspring God promised who will defeat the devil.
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little — how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: If you ever feel ashamed, don’t hide from God like Adam and Eve did; run to God instead! God has promised to forgive and restore those who come to Him.
I hope you enjoyed this story. When can we meet again?
Do you think someone else should hear this story?
